peoples_entry.name: Ring Sea Sailors, Smugglers & Corsairs
peoples_entry.note: Polyglot 1.93–2.0 atm Ring Sea maritime crews across three interlocking strata — blue-water merchant & Port Mira truce-port sailors, De Xedaz / Shanty / Boiling-Bay Brimstone cove-smugglers & false-beacon wreckers, and Hooked-Sun freebooters of Hookfleet & Noah's Regret — including Admiral Vasko Marxal's PF-01 Restorationists and Dread Admiral Bloody Ruephus.
